captions.detailed: A bench-scale monocular laboratory microscope featuring a gray-painted metal body, a heavy rectangular base, and an upright supporting arm. It includes a black rectangular slide stage with adjustment knobs, a rotating brass-colored objective nosepiece, and a black eyepiece tube angled at the top. The nosepiece can rotate continuously, the main body carriage slides vertically for focusing, the stage carriage slides horizontally along one axis, and a small diaphragm lever rotates on a pivot beneath the stage.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a laboratory monocular microscope with a heavy gray base, an upright arm, a black adjustable slide stage, and a brass-colored revolving nosepiece. The model must support continuous rotation of the nosepiece, vertical translation of the focusing body, horizontal translation of the stage, and rotational pivot of the diaphragm lever.
captions.factory: The code defines a multi-part assembly using CadQuery. It starts by defining materials for the gray body, black stage, and brass nosepiece. Solid geometries are constructed using primitives such as cylinders and boxes, combined with boolean operations to form the detailed base, arm, stage, eyepiece, and controls. Finally, the parts are linked together with appropriate joints: a continuous revolute joint for the revolving nosepiece, prismatic joints for the focusing carriage and stage movement, and a revolute joint for the diaphragm lever.
